title: PhysioRAG: Evidence-Based Physiotherapy AI
description: A citation-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation system using LangChain, BioBERT, and ChromaDB over 20,000+ research articles. Achieved a 0.89 Faithfulness score (RAGAS), with a focus on reliable, evidence-based physiotherapy responses. Earned Best Paper (1st Place) at IEEE SSD 2026, Italy.
summary: Citation-grounded physiotherapy AI over 20,000+ research articles. Best Paper, 1st Place at IEEE SSD 2026.

title: Real-Time Predictive Maintenance System
description: Built a real-time data collection system using ESP32 sensors to monitor vibration and temperature. Designed a Flask-based backend serving LSTM models for multi-step time-series forecasting. Implemented live dashboards and monitoring to improve observability and early fault detection.
summary: An ESP32 sensor pipeline and LSTM forecasting system for real-time predictive maintenance.

title: Community Issue Reporting Platform
description: Engineered a full-stack application with React.js, Flask REST APIs, and MySQL for issue reporting, tracking, assignment, and administrative workflows. Implemented JWT authentication, role-based access control, and Leaflet map dashboards to visualize and manage issues.
summary: Issue reporting and tracking with role-based access, JWT authentication, and Leaflet map dashboards.

title: Automatic Door Locking System
description: Built a smartphone-controlled IoT security system using local network communication. Implemented secure device control and real-time status monitoring for enhanced home security.
summary: A smartphone-controlled IoT door lock with local-network communication and live status monitoring.

title: NoCodeML Tool
description: A user-friendly tool that allows users to upload CSV files, select ML models, and train them without writing code. Supports both regression and classification tasks.
summary: Upload a CSV, choose a model, and train regression or classification models without writing code.

title: GhostMask - Privacy-Preserving GenAI Pipeline
description: Built a six-node Python/LangGraph pipeline for PII detection, secure tokenization, and contextual text reconstruction using Presidio, spaCy NER, and Gemma 2B. Implemented vault-based token mapping and a Gradio interface to inspect processing stages and support auditable LLM interactions. Used ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot to support implementation and refinement.
summary: A six-node GenAI pipeline that detects PII, securely tokenizes it, and reconstructs context with auditable vault mapping.

title: ChatGuard IDS - Secure Chat and ML-Based Threat Detection
description: Built a TCP client-server system with AES-256-GCM encryption, PBKDF2 authentication, access controls, and security logging. Applied TF-IDF, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Isolation Forest to flag spam, phishing, and anomalous client behavior.
summary: Encrypted TCP chat with AES-256-GCM and ML-based detection of spam, phishing, and anomalous client behavior.
